integrity: The proof is analytic. The only source-specific ingredients are the exact HJW reduction and strict-convex scalar objective from arXiv:2608.07145v1; phase independence is independently rederived from a one-qubit determinant. The bundled finite checker is corroborative only.
limitations: Restricted to finite pure-state ensembles of the canonical GHZ–W rank-two family with \(0<\lambda<1\).
No classification is claimed for arbitrary rank-two pairs or infinite ensemble measures.
No new claim is made about LOCC monotonicity of concurrence fill.
title: All optimal finite decompositions of the canonical GHZ–W concurrence-fill mixture
